sources: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/pioneer-trail-park/ (Cloudflare refuses plain HTTP; read in a browser)
https://www.campspot.com/book/pioneertrailparkcampground (the county's reservation link; Campspot park record in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13)

values.note: Delta County's 2026 rates, one rate for everyone (no county-resident rate): basic electric and water $40, full hook-up $45, river/lake-view sites $45; $5 a day extra on the Friday and Saturday of Spooktacular (Sept 18-20). A non-refundable $5 reservation fee on any booking made ahead; card payments add a 4% processing fee. 30-day stays $900; 157-night seasonal sites $2,750-3,250 by signed agreement. Cabins $65 (2-night minimum).

fees.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/rates-fees-policies/ ('Basic (Electric &Water ONLY) – $40 per night', 'Full Hook-up (Electric, Water & SEWER) – $45 per night (Pioneer Trail Park ONLY ...)', 'River/Lake View Sites – $45 per night', 'If a site is booked in advance, a NON-REFUNDABLE $5.00 fee is added', 'A 4% NON-REFUNDABLE processing fee will be added to your total cost'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/pioneer-trail-park/ ('78 sites with electric (50 AMP) and water hookups as well as 21 sites with electric (50 AMP), water, and sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 78 water-and-electric sites and 21 full-hookup sites (6 of the water-and-electric are river sites, 10 pull-through); also 5 rustic cabins on the river with electricity but no water.

sites.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/pioneer-trail-park/ ('78 sites ... 21 sites ...', '5 rustic cabins along the Escanaba River shoreline') + the park's Campspot record (Basic Pull-Through RV Site x10, Basic RV Site x61, Full Hookup RV Site x21, River Site x6, all max length 50 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Modern bathhouse; two dump stations; firewood sold at the office ($7.50 a bundle), and outside firewood must be inspected.

facilities.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/pioneer-trail-park/ ('Campground amenities include a modern bathhouse, showers, laundry, two dump stations, fire pits for each site and firewood') + rates-fees-policies/, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Daily and monthly reservations are paid in full when booked; seasonal sites by phone on weekdays. Check-in 1pm at the office or camp host, check-out noon (Eastern).

booking.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/rates-fees-policies/ ('Holiday weekends require a 2- day minimum for prior booking', 'All Daily and Monthly Reservations: MUST BE PAID IN FULL AT THE TIME OF THE RESERVATION', 'Please call office for booking a Seasonal') + the county's 'Pioneer Trail Park Reservations' link to https://www.campspot.com/book/pioneertrailparkcampground, read 2026-10-22

note: Delta County park on 74 acres along the Escanaba River at Gladstone, with a boat launch, disc golf, kayak rentals and five rustic riverside cabins. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Delta County's pages (browser; Cloudflare blocks plain HTTP): $40-45 for 2026 with the $5 reservation fee (one rate, no resident split), 50-amp with water at all 99 sites and sewer at 21, showers/laundry/two dump stations, Campspot booking. Added max length 50 ft and pull-throughs from the Campspot record, holiday 2-night minimum, booking link to /book/. Note: dropped the hookup-count sentence (now in sites.note).
